name: Loudplay
what_it_is: A cloud gaming service where you buy time on a cloud gaming PC and stream it to a Windows, macOS or Android device, bringing your own game licenses.
pricing: Desktop hours are prepaid: 3 hours for $3.99, 10 hours for $8.99 and 20 hours for $15.99, each valid 30 days with no auto-renewal. Android plans are Google Play subscriptions priced per region.
key_features: Bring your own Steam and Epic licenses
notable: Does not sell games; users play titles they already own
Terms name Loudplay AM LLC in Yerevan, Armenia as the operator

facts.fact: Loudplay is a cloud gaming service for desktop (Windows and macOS) and Android where you buy time on a cloud gaming PC and bring your own game licenses.
Desktop packages are 3 hours for $3.99, 10 hours for $8.99 and 20 hours for $15.99, one-time purchases valid for 30 days.
The terms of use name Loudplay AM LLC in Yerevan, Armenia as the service administration and describe a proprietary real-time streaming protocol.
The home page says games can be downloaded from stores like Steam and Epic Games and that a stable connection of at least 10 Mbps is needed.
